column1: # The models Splash suggests, best first: the Mac app offers them and shell
# completion completes them. MODEL<TAB>NAME<TAB>MEMORY: the ID splash serve
# --model takes, the model's name, and the smallest Mac memory in GB the
# variant is meant for. The app offers, per name, the variant with the most
# MEMORY that the Mac has; README.md's Models table must list only these IDs.
